feature: Android Auto A-Z Media App Compliance

kotlin_service.details: MediaBrowserServiceCompat, MediaSessionCompat with full Callback, onPlayFromMediaId, play/pause/stop/skip handlers, native MediaPlayer, AudioFocus, metadata, playback states, content style hints, favorites from AsyncStorage

manifest_config.details: Attribution icon, accent color theme, car.application meta-data, navigation permissions stripped, CarPlayService blocked, MegaRadioAutoService as sole MediaBrowserService

trackplayer_fix.details: MediaBrowserService intent removed from MusicService, foregroundServiceType=mediaPlayback preserved

fixed_issues: MediaSession had no Callback - Android Auto commands (play/pause/skip) were ignored
onPlayFromMediaId was missing - tapping a station did nothing
No native MediaPlayer - no actual audio playback in Android Auto
No AudioFocus management - could interfere with other apps
No MediaMetadata set - Now Playing screen was blank
Missing Accent Color Theme (car.application.theme) - Google requirement
No Content Style Hints - Android Auto used default layout
Icon URI used wrong package name (com.visiongo.megaradio vs com.megaradio) - removed custom icon URIs
withTrackPlayerServiceFix re-added MediaBrowserService intent to MusicService - conflicted with MegaRadioAutoService
notes: This is a config plugin validation. Actual Android Auto testing requires building an APK and testing with Android Auto DHU (Desktop Head Unit) or a real car head unit.
